verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ מִזְמֽוֹר׃ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֬רַח תִּקְעוּ־ כָ֑ף כָּֽל־ הָ֭עַמִּים הָרִ֥יעוּ לֵ֝אלֹהִ֗ים בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ tiq·‘ū- ḵāp̄ kāl- hā·‘am·mîm hā·rî·‘ū lê·lō·hîm bə·qō·wl rin·nāh
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of the sons of Korah Clap your hands all you peoples . . . shout unto God with a voice of triumph

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נוֹרָ֑א יְהוָ֣ה עֶלְי֣וֹן גָּ֝דוֹל מֶ֥לֶךְ עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nō·w·rā Yah·weh ‘el·yō·wn gā·ḏō·wl me·leḵ ‘al- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: How awesome [is] the LORD Most High the great King over all the earth

verses.original: יַדְבֵּ֣ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתֵּ֑ינוּ וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים תַּ֣חַת רַגְלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.literal: He subdues nations beneath us and peoples under our feet

verses.original: יִבְחַר־ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתֵ֑נוּ אֶ֥ת לָ֥נוּ גְּא֨וֹן יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁר־ אָהֵ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yiḇ·ḥar- ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ’eṯ lā·nū gə·’ō·wn ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·šer- ’ā·hêḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: He chooses - our inheritance - for us the pride of Jacob whom He loves Selah

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים עָלָ֣ה בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה בְּק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.literal: God has ascended amid shouts of joy the LORD with the sound of the horn

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים זַמֵּ֑רוּ זַמְּר֖וּ לְמַלְכֵּ֣נוּ זַמֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.literal: Sing praises to God sing praises sing praises to our King sing praises

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֱלֹהִ֗ים מֶ֖לֶךְ כָּל־ הָאָ֥רֶץ זַמְּר֥וּ מַשְׂכִּֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm me·leḵ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ zam·mə·rū maś·kîl
verses.literal: For God is King of all the earth sing to Him a psalm of praise . . .

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים מָלַ֣ךְ עַל־ גּוֹיִ֑ם אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יָשַׁ֤ב׀ עַל־ קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ כִּסֵּ֬א
verses.literal: God reigns over the nations God is seated on His holy throne

verses.original: נְדִ֘יבֵ֤י עַמִּ֨ים׀ נֶאֱסָ֗פוּ עַם֮ אֱלֹהֵ֪י אַבְרָ֫הָ֥ם כִּ֣י מָֽגִנֵּי־ אֶ֗רֶץ לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים מְאֹ֣ד נַעֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ḏî·ḇê ‘am·mîm ne·’ĕ·sā·p̄ū ‘am ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām kî mā·ḡin·nê- ’e·reṣ lê·lō·hîm mə·’ōḏ na·‘ă·lāh
verses.literal: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham for the shields of the earth belong to God He is highly exalted
